metadata.description:
This POAP is made specially for the subscribers of the Weekly Thing to celebrate the 300th issue of the newsletter. The very first Weekly Thing was sent on May 13, 2017 and the 300th on November 9, 2024! The claim code was sent directly to each member that received the 300th issue.
